referenceSet.shows: Home hero: paper ground, 96px headline, black CTA + bordered search, pink ink-outlined coin stickers scattered and cropped at the edges, marketing header with black current pill and full-height CTA block. The bar for overall composition and sticker placement.
Pricing: a marigold band hero with lemon coin stickers, closed by a 1px black seam into a periwinkle | teal split band. The bar for poster color blocking.
Features: lemon band, white receipt stickers, pink process ribbon with lemon tool stickers - how far the color and sticker language goes.
Close-up of the stacked-plate hover: black CTA lifted -8px over lemon and red plates with black borders.
Close-up of the app hard-shadow lift: pink button -4px with a 4px 4px 0 black shadow, and pressed flat.
Product chrome: lemon category header band with search and pills, hairline filter stack, dashed empty state, black subscribe footer - the bar for app screens without content images.
Form/settings-like screen: pill sub-nav, option cards with a pink selected border, 48px inputs, bordered panel, toggle - how dense UI keeps the ink-hairline character.
Help index: 4-up white tiles with 1px black borders on paper, pink and outline header buttons - a dense grid that stays flat and drawn.
Pricing on a phone: marigold band with stickers cropped at the edges, then a periwinkle band with a big fee number - bands stack with black seams.
App screen on a phone: lemon header band, stacked filter box, dashed empty state and black footer with pink arrow button.
Dark appearance: black ground, pink stickers unchanged, CTA turns pink, current nav pill turns white.
Tag marquee frames: white tag pills alternating with flat colored ink-outlined sticker icons, sliding linearly.
